watchOut: The ARGUS Platinum rating and safety record are its own statements.
name: Ventura Air Services
roleBasis: Its homepage says: "Ventura stands out by managing its own fleet" and that it was founded in 1955 as a boutique airline charter operation.
summary: Fleet-managing operator with an ARGUS Platinum rating and a cost page that gives no figures.
differentiator: Says it manages its own fleet and holds ARGUS Platinum. Its cost page lists what pushes a price up, handling, overnight crew, catering, ground transport and repositioning, but gives no number beyond saying rentals "can begin at a few thousand dollars per hour".
priceNote: No dollar figures on the cost page, only the statement that charter can begin at a few thousand dollars per hour.
operatorDisclosure: Says it manages its own fleet. The pages we read do not say whether it also sources aircraft from other operators.
bestFor: Buyers who want to deal with a fleet operator directly and are happy to get a quote by request.
